arguments.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS unlabelled_transactions FROM transactions t WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fraud_labels f WHERE f.transaction_id = CAST(t.id AS TEXT))
arguments.explanation: This counts the transactions that have no row in the fraud labels table. Their fraud status is unknown, which is not the same as legitimate.
assumptions: I took 'no fraud label' to mean the transaction has no matching row in fraud_labels. A transaction labelled is_fraud = 0 has a label, so it is not counted.
